---
title: Two cells
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'cell-id: "annotated-cell-1", annotations: \("1": 1, "2": 2\)'
          - 'cell-id: "annotated-cell-2", annotations: \("1": 1, "2": 2\)'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
          - '# <1>'
---

```{.python}
x = 1  # <1>
y = 2  # <2>
```

1. First.
2. Second.

```{.python}
a = 1  # <1>
b = 2  # <2>
```

1. Third.
2. Fourth.
